subject: Hosting-ready dining and hallway storage for Christmas
hook: Watch a sideboard go from flat board to soft-close doors in 30 seconds.
ig:
Watch a sideboard go from flat board to soft-close doors in 30 seconds.

This is how we work on a made-to-measure sideboard in our Hanley workshop:

Cut: oak-effect board is cut to size on the sliding table panel saw.
Edged: every visible edge is finished on the edge bander, so no raw board shows.
Drilled: hinge cups and shelf-pin rows on the multi-spindle boring machine.
Assembled: carcass, drawers and doors put together by us. Not flat-pack, not self-assembly.
Checked: every door and drawer tested before it leaves.

A sideboard is one of the hardest-working pieces when you host. The top becomes a serving station, the drawers hold cutlery and napkins, and the cupboards hide the platters until they are needed.

Sizing it to your dining room, rather than the other way round, is the whole point.

See the sideboard page via the link in bio.
